dishName.title: Dish name
dishName.description: Dish name translated into the output language. Null if it could not be extracted.

originalName.title: Original name
originalName.description: Dish name exactly as printed on the menu. Null if not available.

category.title: Category
category.description: Menu section the dish belongs to (e.g. Pizze, Antipasti). Null if not available.

price.title: Price
price.description: Price including currency symbol, exactly as printed. Null if not available.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.description: Atomic ingredients of the dish, each with its EU-14 (or US-9) allergen tags.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: Ingredient name in the output language.

eu14Allergens.title: EU-14 allergens
eu14Allergens.description: Allergen tags for this ingredient with confidence scores (0-1).

allergen.title: Allergen
allergen.description: Allergen key (EU-14 or US-9 framework), e.g. gluten, milk, eggs, peanuts.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence score for this allergen tag (0-1).

dietaryType.title: Dietary type
dietaryType.description: Dietary classification: vegan, vegetarian, pescetarian, or other.

dietaryExplanation.title: Dietary explanation
dietaryExplanation.description: Human-readable explanation of the dietary classification.
dietaryExplanation.example: Free of meat and fish; contains dairy-derived ingredients.

allergenSummary.title: Allergen summary
allergenSummary.description: Human-readable summary of allergens in the dish, e.g. 'Contains gluten, milk'.

nutritionEstimate.title: Nutrition estimate
nutritionEstimate.description: Estimated nutrition per serving. Individual values are null when unknown.

proteinG.title: Protein (g)
proteinG.description: Estimated protein in grams. Null if unavailable.

fatG.title: Fat (g)
fatG.description: Estimated fat in grams. Null if unavailable.

carbsG.title: Carbs (g)
carbsG.description: Estimated carbohydrates in grams. Null if unavailable.

sourceImageUrl.title: Source image URL
sourceImageUrl.description: URL of the menu image or PDF this dish was extracted from.

extractionTimestamp.title: Extraction timestamp
extractionTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the record was extracted.

menuEffectiveDate.title: Menu effective date
menuEffectiveDate.description: Validity date printed on the menu (e.g. 'Summer 2026'). Null if not present.

actorRunId.title: Actor run ID
actorRunId.description: Apify run ID that produced this record (or 'local-dev' for local runs).

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: Allergen framework applied: EU (14 allergens) or US-CA (9 allergens).

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Overall extraction confidence for this dish (0-1).

needsReview.title: Needs review
needsReview.description: True when confidence is below 0.6 and a human should verify the record.
